description: The message format MCP uses: requests with an `id` and `method`, responses with `result` or `error`, notifications without `id` that get no response.
Since MCP 2026-07-28, every request carries `io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion` and `io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities`, so servers keep no session.
The method every 2026-07-28 server implements: supported protocol versions, capabilities, identity and optional instructions in one call.
A JSON-RPC error response (unknown tool, malformed request, unsupported version). Models can rarely fix these.
A normal `tools/call` result with `isError: true` and a text explanation (invalid values, failing API) that the model can use to retry.
Machine-readable tool output returned next to the text `content`, optionally described by the tool's `outputSchema`.
Read-only context identified by a URI and read with `resources/read`. The host application decides when it enters the context.
`initialize` followed by `notifications/initialized`, used by MCP revisions up to 2025-11-25 to negotiate a session.
